sanitization: Minimal structured facts only. No transcripts, credentials, repository paths, personal destinations, or live database copy are included.

files.cohort-summary.json: Expected aggregate baseline and per-task linkage counts.
files.repair-quota-reroute.json: Operational fallback must retain repair obligations.
files.reviewer-binary-missing.json: Missing reviewer executable is operational, not a code defect.
files.missing-tsc-gate.json: Missing compiler gate evidence remains an environment error.
files.advisory-clarification-review.json: Advisory question is not rewritten as a blocking defect.
files.dependency-recovered.json: Dependency-only blockage can be reconsidered after recovery.
